patch.value: Release coverage gate is below 100 percent and omits executable tooling

The baseline release gate passes because package thresholds are lines 91 branches 77 and functions 93 over index.ts only. Actual measured coverage is 93.40 percent lines 80.33 percent branches and 95.28 percent functions; no independent statements metric is reported, and executable TypeScript gates plus the JavaScript merge-driver helper are outside the measured production set. value.author: ox-alpha
value.text: Branch fix/exact-coverage-gate created off baf512f. Inventory: index.ts, scripts/coverage-gate.ts, scripts/docstring-gate.ts, scripts/prepare-merge-driver.mjs (to migrate to erasable TS). Working region by region through the uncovered error/refusal paths.

patch.value: Exact independent 100 percent statements/branches/functions/lines achieved and enforced. Scope: index.ts plus all executable tooling (scripts/coverage-gate.ts, scripts/docstring-gate.ts, scripts/prepare-merge-driver.ts) = 4 source files reported by the gate; V8 reports statements as lines so the lines threshold IS the statements metric on this runtime (documented in CoverageThresholds). Changes: (1) coverage-gate.ts restructured into pure runGate/evaluateRun/collectReportedFiles exports behind an isMainInvocation guard (docstring-gate contract), so the gate is itself measured by its own suite and drivable against fixture repos; root argument now required at invocation (fail-closed). (2) prepare-merge-driver.mjs migrated to erasable TypeScript with injectable platform/PATH/exec; .mjs deleted; npm prepare updated. (3) coverageGate strengthened to sources ['.','scripts'] with thresholds exactly 100/100/100 and ignore []. (4) Adversarial/mutation checks added: fixture-repo tests prove the gate fails naming an unexecuted source, fails a threshold regression, rejects every ignore-entry escape (not-under-sources, unverifiable compiler, missing emit, runtime-emitting), refuses stale/missing lcov reports, strips runner-context env so nested measurement cannot silently skip the report, and proves the shipped script fails closed when run as main without a root. (5) 287 tests total across 8 files; all failure/recovery paths of the importer/exporter/diff/validate driven black-box through a scripted real pm executable (test/fixtures/stub-pm.ts). Gates: npm run release:check exit 0 (typecheck+build+docstring+coverage+audit+pack+deterministic changelog); identical npm run coverage step present in ci.yml so CI enforces the exact gate.
